## IMessageReportingRule.logLevel property

How the message should be logged. - 'error': Treated as an error (fails the build) - 'warning': Treated as a warning - 'info': Informational only - 'none': Suppressed completely

**Signature:**

```typescript
logLevel: 'error' | 'warning' | 'info' | 'none';
```
